programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.desc: SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to "SportsCenter" viewers. programme.title: Nothing Good Ever Happens
programme.desc: Neil who is a painter and graphic designer, on a morning just like any other morning his girlfriend Amanda leaves him and moves out of their house (don't worry, it's a rental.) That morning Neil tries to cope as best he knows how, but in a strange turn of events he ends up shooting back a glass of bleach. He wakes up to suicide watch and court appointed therapy as well as the empty void Amanda left. Now Neil has to decide what he can do to feel better about himself. Should he get Amanda back? Make his old friends like him again? Confront his estranged father? Eat a ton of Chinese food? Or maybe he should just finish his latest goddamned painting.

programme.title: Kahwa
programme.desc: Set in July 2016, in the kashmir valley, post the encounter of militant Burhan Wadi, a period that had resulted in the loss of almost 70 lives and injured over 11000 people. A young CRPF official called Surkhab is sent to kashmir as a part of his very first posting along with a few other officers in the very first week of this curfew. Although he so posted in a small base where the clashes were not seen, yet he senses a feeling of fear and tense throughout. Surkhab who is very proud & committed army officer and at the same time mesmerised by the beauty of the valley and often wonders why a place so beautiful feels like a war zone. He arrives in the area and is assigned to maintain peace during the volatile period. He is determined to do his job with utmost sincerity and discipline. During one of his rounds, Surkhab meets Shaukhat, a tea seller, who is initially reluctant to interact with him due to the ongoing tensions. However, Surkhab insists on having a cup of tea with him, and slowly, they start talking about their lives and experiences. Shaukat has a grandson who loves to play cricket but is snatched the freedom of doing so due to the curfew. He gets together with some of his adult friends and they often secretly play gully cricket. As the curfew continues, Surkhab and Shaukat's bond grows stronger, and they discuss the unrest in the neighborhood, their families, and their dreams for a peaceful future. Despite their initial differences, Surkhab and Shaukhat find a common ground of acceptance and understanding over their shared cups of tea.However, this new found equation is put to the test when an unexpected event takes place, forcing them to confront their beliefs and loyalties. Kahwa is a story of how two individuals from vastly different backgrounds and ideologies can come together and form a bond of acceptance and empathy, even in the face of adversity.

programme.title: Vishaad

What begins as a routine inquiry slowly unfolds into an encounter with memory itself where loss finds an intangible resonance, and silence begins to speak. Vishaad is a lyrical meditation on grief, time, and the fragile human desire to regurgitate all that the heart has tried to bury.

programme.sub-title: Loïc Bruni's chase for GOAT status, and a shocking season-final no-show, reveals a village behind a champion
programme.desc: Highlights and all the action from the sport of mountain biking across the world.

programme.title: Beyond the ROX
programme.sub-title: HYROX athletes grind in the off-season to balance their personal lives with the ambition, endurance, recovery, and mental and physical strength required to compete with the Elite 15
programme.desc: The best HYROX athletes uncover what it takes to rise to the top.

programme.title: Premier Padel Highlights
programme.sub-title: Relive the action from Egypt as padel pros tackled the NEWGIZA Premier Padel P2 tournament
programme.desc: Highlights, replays and more of Premier Padel Tennis tournaments from around the world.

programme.title: Skate Tales
programme.sub-title: Madars meets Japan's underground skate star Kento Yoshioka, also known as Japanese Super Rat
programme.desc: Skateboarder Madars Apse travels the world to skate with and learn from people pushing the culture of skateboarding in their own special way.

programme.title: Neymar Jr. Full Access
programme.desc: Join Neymar Jr. for an exclusive look at life beyond the game and how he spends his hard-earned downtime.

programme.title: Reel Rock
programme.sub-title: Join Alex Honnold and Cedar Wright in one of the coldest and most remote places on Earth: Antarctica. No strangers to sufferfests, this duo tackle massive granite towers
programme.desc: Follows the world's top climbers, alpinists and mountaineers to the wildest places on Earth. New stories of triumph, failure and redemption unfold as they pursue the thrill of adventure.

programme.title: Jaan Roose: Life on the Line
programme.desc: World champion slackliner Jaan Roose makes history as the first person to walk a record-breaking 3.6 km slackline across the Strait of Messina, from mainland Italy to Sicily.

programme.title: Life of Kai
programme.sub-title: Surf brothers Kai and Ridge Lenny relive their epic XXL wave ride at Maui's Jaws surf spot, and Kai lets us go BTS to have a look at his state-of-the-art surf equipment testing
programme.desc: Ride shotgun with Kai Lenny as he redefines what's possible in the world's biggest waves, chasing his dreams to become the ultimate waterman.

programme.title: WRC: More Than Machine
programme.sub-title: As the M-Sport season concludes, focus shifts to securing drivers for next year. Adrien Fourmaux ponders his future and Gregoire Munster pushes hard to keep his car on the track
programme.desc: Series following members of the M-Sport WRC team about the trials and tribulations of competing in Rally driving at the highest level.

programme.title: Premier Padel Highlights
programme.sub-title: Watch the action from the Miami Premier Padel P1 as it joins the padel tournament for the first time in 2025
programme.desc: Highlights, replays and more of Premier Padel Tennis tournaments from around the world.

programme.title: Reel Rock
programme.desc: Follows the world's top climbers, alpinists and mountaineers to the wildest places on Earth. New stories of triumph, failure and redemption unfold as they pursue the thrill of adventure.

programme.title: Padel Explained: An Essential Guide

programme.title: Cycling
programme.sub-title: Pogačar, Vingegaard, Roglič and Isaac del Toro gathered together in an unprecedented challenge. No teams, no collective strategies, pure talent facing the mountains and the asphalt. Two settings will put them to the test

programme.desc: NRI Shyam comes to India to fulfil the final wish of his late mother who wanted him to marry an Indian girl. Unbeknownst to him, the girl he falls in love with is a pawn in the hands of his enemies.

programme.title: Blackmail
programme.desc: Kailash's uncle discovers a formula to save energy, which could make him very wealthy. Mr Mehta, an industrialist, envies his success and devises an evil plan to steal the formula.

programme.desc: After the murder of millionaire Ranjit Rai, his mistress Radha is apprehended by the police. Journalist Rakesh teams up with his friends and a skilled defence lawyer to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Hotel Milan
programme.desc: Vipul and Saurabh, two friends, decide to put an end to the misery of couples by starting a love hotel. However, the local political group is not in favour of their venture.

programme.title: Auzaar
programme.desc: Suraj, a police officer, is assigned to arrest his friend Yash, whose father runs an illegal business. He must now persuade his friend to make his father change his ways to avoid the consequences.

programme.title: Ranbanka

programme.desc: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity.

programme.title: Kaala Bairavan
programme.desc: Jogeshwari is the daughter of Dakshan who hates Shiva and worships Vishnu. When Dakshan forces Jogeshwari to marry, she rebels because of her dedication towards Bhairavan, a devout devotee of Shiva.

programme.desc: Generations of rivalry come to light as two families fight for control of a revered temple while personal emotions complicate the path to peace.

programme.title: Thamarai

programme.desc: Selvi, a young girl, has academic ambition that she wants to pursue by moving to the city from her village. However, her family wants her to get married.

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.sub-title: Reveals the mouthwatering secrets behind tasty treats. It's a wild culinary ride as mountains of raw materials are transformed. Featuring healthy muffins and red-hot candies
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. Through the ingredients, techniques and required processes, `Food Factory' reveals how raw ingredients are turned into everyday eats. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.desc: The gold rush in Alaska isn't confined to the state's precious ground. It's taking place on the sea ... or more accurately, on the bottom of the frigid Bering Sea. The custom-built rigs, some barely seaworthy, include an 80-foot barge run by the most successful gold dredger in Nome, Alaska, and a modified skiff that seats only two people.
